description: A bundler for javascript and friends. Packs many modules into a few bundled assets. Code Splitting allows for loading parts of the application on demand. Through "loaders", modules can be CommonJs, AMD, ES6 modules, CSS, Images, JSON, Coffeescript, LESS, ... and your custom stuff.
commit_message:
fix(css): keep the digits Firefox lays a percentage out with (#22718)

* fix(css): keep the digits Firefox lays a percentage out with

Six significant digits are calibrated on Blink's 1/64px layout. Gecko
parses a percentage as a single-precision float and lays it out in
1/60px, so `calc(100% / 3)` printed as `33.3333%` moved a
`translateX(100%)` by 0.03px in the Radix Themes benchmark. A
percentage now keeps the fewest digits, six or more, that parse to the
